sections.title: Volunteer Representative — Philippines
paragraphs: Served as a full-time volunteer representative in the Philippines, focusing on teaching, mentoring, and community service. The role required strong leadership, cross-cultural communication, and adaptability while working closely with local communities.
list: Taught and mentored 10+ individuals daily in both Tagalog and English, adapting instruction to diverse cultural and educational backgrounds.
Directed and supported a team of 12 volunteer representatives, providing leadership, training, and performance feedback.
Led and participated in landscaping and cleanup service projects benefiting over 500 students and community members.
Lived with and trained groups of up to 8 volunteers at a time, providing ongoing instruction, coordination, and support.

entries.title: Eagle Scout Award
entries.summary: Earned the highest rank in the Boy Scouts of America through leadership, service, and completion of a community safety project.

detail.title: Eagle Scout Award
detail.subtitle: Leadership, service, and project management achievement.

sections.title: Eagle Scout — Boy Scouts of America
paragraphs: Earned the Eagle Scout rank, the highest achievement in the Boy Scouts of America, awarded for sustained leadership, service, and personal development. Completion required planning and leading a community service project that addressed a real-world public safety need.
list: Planned and led a community service project to repaint faded red curbs in front of fire hydrants throughout a residential neighborhood, improving visibility and emergency access for first responders.
Coordinated volunteers, materials, and scheduling to complete the project safely and efficiently.
Worked with local guidelines to ensure markings met visibility and safety standards.
Managed project planning, execution, and final approval from proposal through completion.
